page.overview:
Who is Link?

My Numero Uno Chum!! Even without a , I know my Numero Uno Chum has my back. We'll be chums forever!|Faux Hero|TFH}}, Mr. Hero

Link (リンク Rinku) is the main protagonist of The Legend of Zelda series. One of Nintendo's flagship characters, he is characterized as a youthful yet exceptionally capable and intrepid swordsman, typically attired in green clothing, whose overarching mission is the defense of the world against pervasive malevolent forces, most prominently the Kingdom of Hyrule. His narrative consistently emphasizes acts of extraordinary courage, strategic acumen, and resilience in overcoming formidable adversities and intricate challenges.

Link's debut occurred in the 1986 action-adventure title The Legend of Zelda, released for the Nintendo Entertainment System (originally in Japan on the Family Computer Disk System). Since that inaugural appearance, he has been a constant presence in virtually all mainline entries in the franchise, with the sole exceptions being the Japan-exclusive Satellaview titles, which are regarded as non-canonical.

Within the narrative canon, Link occupies a central triadic relationship alongside Princess Zelda and Ganon. Zelda frequently functions as both his strategic ally and, in certain iterations, a romantic interest, whereas Ganon embodies his persistent and defining arch-nemesis. Across the franchise, Link's incarnations exhibit recurring motifs of heroism, moral fortitude, and mastery of both martial and mystical skills, thereby establishing him as an enduring emblem of Nintendo’s legacy in interactive entertainment.

Also known as: Hero of Time, Hero of the Wild.
